key_stat: Invests in 36 economies | ~€13B annual investment | Green Economy Transition
summary: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) invests in private enterprise across 36 emerging economies from Central Europe to Central Asia and the Southern/Eastern Mediterranean. ~€13B annual investment. Key themes: Green Economy Transition (GET), digital transformation, private sector development. Technology needs: portfolio management, risk systems, data analytics, digital lending platforms, ESG reporting, cybersecurity. Formal procurement processes.
